Restaurant where food and service come first
Feb 2025 • Couples
Crab House Restaurant specializes in crab dishes and other seafood. The establishment is decorated in an American style, creating a cozy atmosphere for visitors. The menu is varied and offers a wide selection of seafood. Crab, lobster, scallop and shrimp dishes are of high quality. Prices are higher than average, but the quality and taste of the dishes justify the cost. Separately worth mentioning is the high quality of service, the staff is friendly and attentive, which contributes to a pleasant experience of the visit.
Unequivocally, Crab House is recommended for seafood lovers looking for top quality food, a pleasant atmosphere and impeccable service.

Average restaurant, nice vibe, friendly staff.
Feb 2025 • Couples
The restaurant is almost like an American Diner themed restaurant. If you’re looking for something that is chilled with an atmosphere then this is a nice spot. It isn’t what I would class as a “typical” Vietnamese restaurant, however the food is all locally sourced. If you’re a seafood fan you might be disappointed with the portions. 

In a nutshell: 

Pros: 

Friendly staff 
Nice atmosphere 
Extensive menu 

Cons:

Small portions 
Arguably expensive for what you get
Rushed service. 

Feedback: 

The appetiser was delivered with the main. This made our experience feel rushed. The restaurant was busy so that’s maybe why it felt like we needed to be in and then out ASAP.
Also the crab portions were tiny for what you get/ pay for. 

I probably wouldn’t go back, but it’s a nice vibe and I’m pleased I had an opportunity to visit. If you’re looking for bigger portions, or seafood is your go to, you might be disappointed.
